seo__search_description: Thanks for applying to volunteer with Oakdene House Foundation. We'll be in touch within 2 business days.
hero__title: Thanks for applying to volunteer with Oakdene
content__text: We'll be in touch within 2 business days to arrange a brief chat. In the meantime, feel free to explore our [services](/services/) and [community programs](/community-programs/) — it's a good way to get a feel for how Oakdene works. If you have questions in the meantime, call us on [(02) 8717 0999](tel:0287170999) or email [admin@oakdenehouse.org.au](mailto:admin@oakdenehouse.org.au).
